metadata.title: Oracle Stock Was Caught In the AI Debt Selloff. Wall Street Says That’s a Mistake.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Oracle Stock Was Caught In the AI Debt Selloff. Wall Street Says That’s a Mistake.
Oracle massive artificial-intelligence ambitions have become a liability for its stock as concerns mount about the billions of dollars needed to finance its expansion. Some analysts believe those fears may have been overblown.
